name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | Retention, NRR, Expansion & AI-Driven Book Management
summary: Customer success and account manager with 15+ years in SaaS, owning revenue outcomes across a book, not just satisfaction. Retained all but one of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye (~94%) on deals of $10K-$45K, held 120% of sales targets at Wix, and ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota roughly doubled. Builds multi-stakeholder relationships up to the C-suite, runs business reviews, and drives upsells from what the customer is already trying to do. Uses AI daily, building LLM-powered workflows and scoring logic that surface account risk and opportunity faster.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Use AI tools daily and build LLM-powered workflows (OpenAI, Claude, n8n, Make) that analyze accounts, score digital footprint, and prioritize the highest-impact outreach.
Built automated retention and reactivation campaigns that bring past customers back, part of a 20+ workflow lifecycle system covering onboarding, nurture, and reviews.
Expand scope with existing clients, identifying complementary services and writing the proposals and statements of work to close them.
Own the client relationship from onboarding through ongoing delivery, reporting results to business owners with dashboards tracking ROI.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led quarterly business reviews for ~3 multi-stakeholder accounts at $20K+/month ad spend each (peaks above $100K/month), reporting ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs.
Coordinated execution across internal departments as strategic lead, resolving client feedback promptly to protect retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a book of 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes of ~$10K-$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and intervene before they turned into churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and product value, deepening engagement across health, home services, and retail verticals.
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that reduced onboarding friction across a high-volume partner network (50+ daily activities).
Routed structured customer feedback to Product and Engineering, linking field signals to roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each, several exceeding $25K, for roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, and led the sales team.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding and launching 25+ clients per month.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training sessions, 1:1 coaching, and workshops for new initiatives.
Drove team initiatives for a new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank while quota roughly doubled.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, consistently into accelerator tiers.
Wrote proposals and statements of work for agencies and professional-services firms across a global client base, building sequenced implementation plans for the implementation team to execute.
Built C-suite relationships as a trusted advisor, escalating account issues to leadership early and mitigating risk with direct strategic guidance.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle SaaS sales to SMBs, making up to 150 dials/day and closing up to 10 deals/month.
